decisions.reason: The low-pile decorative carpet still has its own page in 2024, so its prospects remain open, and keeping a carpet design in a collection costs little, which argues for holding the option.
The hand-knotted wool silk carpet is a premium craftsmanship piece with continued dedicated presentation, and as a made-to-order item its carrying cost is low, so the firm keeps the option open.

The corner bench moved from its own page to a mention, a weaker signal, but it is still actively described as a new interpretation, so its uncertainty is not yet resolved enough to justify abandoning it.
The low-pile carpet keeps its own page, and a sibling carpet was already pruned, which suggests the surviving variants passed an early screening and are worth retaining cheaply.
The swivel shell chair is a core seating product with sustained dedicated presentation and broad residential and contract potential, so further commitment is more likely than abandonment.
